SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
